title: Canada Yocale: Appointment Management System
description:
Yocale is a cloud-based business management platform that helps appointment-based businesses streamline their daily operations. Founded in Canada, the platform is used by healthcare providers, beauty salons, wellness centers, and other service businesses to manage appointments, client records, payments, and communications in one centralized system.

Price: $5 000 | Size: 51.02 GB | Records: 6 055 490 appointments data | Dump date: 2026
